note: 8-question minimal batch after 01/02 review. SQL is a hand-written candidate; expected values are business assertions on the frozen fixture, not model output.

cases.question: 上海时间 2026 年 11 月创建了多少订单？含未支付和已取消。
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at >= :start_at AND created_at < :end_at
cases.business_assertion: count of orders with created_at in [Nov-01 00:00 +08, Dec-01 00:00 +08), all trade_status
cases.alt_sql: SELECT count(order_id) AS order_count FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at >= :start_at AND created_at < :end_at

cases.question: 上海时间 2026 年 11 月创建、当前属于已支付四状态且 paid_minor>0 的订单数。
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at >= :start_at AND created_at < :end_at AND trade_status IN ('paid','completed','cancelled_refunded','closed_refunded') AND paid_minor > 0
cases.business_assertion: registered orders.count cohort: created_at window + 4 statuses + paid_minor>0
cases.alt_sql: SELECT count(order_id) AS order_count FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at >= :start_at AND created_at < :end_at AND trade_status IN ('paid','completed','cancelled_refunded','closed_refunded') AND paid_minor > 0

cases.question: 上海时间 2026-11-30 这一天创建了多少订单？
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at >= :start_at AND created_at < :end_at
cases.business_assertion: single Shanghai day, no UTC bucket; half-open [Nov-30 00:00 +08, Dec-01 00:00 +08)
cases.alt_sql: SELECT count(order_id) AS order_count FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at >= :start_at AND created_at < :end_at

cases.question: 上海时间 2026 年 11 月创建的已支付订单，原实付总额是多少？含运费。
cases.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(paid_minor),0) AS paid_minor FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at >= :start_at AND created_at < :end_at AND trade_status IN ('paid','completed','cancelled_refunded','closed_refunded') AND paid_minor > 0
cases.business_assertion: registered orders.paid_minor over created_at paid cohort; includes freight, not reduced by later refund
cases.alt_sql: SELECT sum(paid_minor + 0) AS paid_minor_sum FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at >= :start_at AND created_at < :end_at AND trade_status IN ('paid','completed','cancelled_refunded','closed_refunded') AND paid_minor > 0

cases.question: 已确认退款口径为“订单累计退款”后，上海时间 2026 年 11 月我退款了多少钱？
cases.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refunded_minor),0) AS refunded_minor FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at >= :start_at AND created_at < :end_at AND trade_status IN ('paid','completed','cancelled_refunded','closed_refunded') AND paid_minor > 0
cases.business_assertion: S06C 的 clarify 分支见 25 分支计划；本用例只验证 user 已选“订单累计退款”后的 resolved query。等于 registered orders.refunded_minor（含窗后退款），不是钱包到账、不是 02 现金期。
cases.alt_sql: SELECT sum(refunded_minor + 0) AS refunded_minor_sum FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at >= :start_at AND created_at < :end_at AND trade_status IN ('paid','completed','cancelled_refunded','closed_refunded') AND paid_minor > 0

cases.question: SKU sku_1 的当前公开常规价、可售量和价格版本是什么？
cases.sql: SELECT product_id, sku_id, name, price_minor, available_qty, price_version, as_of FROM cs_product_public WHERE sku_id = :sku_id LIMIT 1
cases.business_assertion: public regular price, not promotion; available=stock-reserved; product/sku must be active
cases.alt_sql: SELECT product_id, sku_id, name, price_minor, available_qty, price_version, as_of FROM cs_product_public WHERE sku_id = :sku_id AND price_minor >= 0 LIMIT 1

cases.question: 订单 O2 的订单行、数量、商品实付和已退款数量是什么？
cases.sql: SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.sku_id, oi.ordered_qty, oi.refunded_qty, oi.paid_goods_minor, oi.refunded_goods_minor FROM cs_order_item_self oi JOIN cs_order_self o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.order_id = :order_id ORDER BY oi.order_item_id
cases.business_assertion: escaped order_id is a trusted direct-executor parameter; order_item paid_goods excludes freight; refunded_qty is successful refunded quantity, not return logistics
cases.alt_sql: SELECT order_item_id, sku_id, ordered_qty, refunded_qty, paid_goods_minor, refunded_goods_minor FROM cs_order_item_self WHERE order_id = :order_id AND ordered_qty > 0 ORDER BY order_item_id
